stance_rationale: Sigma의 숫자적 PSD/condition gate는 통과하지만, risk package는 AX-001 1/4 pass, RF-R5 crowding fail, non-degenerate sleeve mix fail을 red_flags=[]/challenge_flags=[]로 침묵 처리한다. 실제 weights.csv와 risk_challenge_note.md가 없고, 2026 STR_1715 top20 static proxy와 가상 70/30 조합으로 AX-005/AX-007 예외를 주장해 risk-stage 승인 근거로 부족하다.

sigma_audit.method_selected: B Omega B' + D; Omega uses Ledoit-Wolf corpcor::cov.shrink, final Sigma not additionally shrunk

regime_sigma_audit.comment: bad/CRISIS monthly IC sample n=29 with no bootstrap CI; package reports regime correlation, not per-regime Sigma.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: HHI is low, but RF-R5 is active: Pearson=0.7112, Spearman=0.7326, daily cross-sleeve corr=0.8491, and lower TDC=0.6154.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: STR_1715 history/crowding uses 2026 admit top20 static proxy across 2004-2026 rather than actual PG2 active-book time series.
Regime classifier uses BM_M_lag with trailing 36m rolling mean/std.
Top20 C2 ADV min reported 2.38e8 KRW; alpha package says ADV_20d_lag1 applied.
No external FRED/ECOS time series used in risk package.
Risk factor returns are built from current 39-ticker top20 union, not a PIT broad KR factor-return panel; no KR FF5 v2 or backfill audit.
Inherited alpha still uses explicit low-vol sign inversion rather than strict Z_Score_Aligned governance.
Risk and alpha code directly read .cache/rawdata.parquet; RAWDATA exemption is asserted, not governance-approved in-package.

critical_concerns.description: No Silent Override breach: risk_package_draft reports red_flags=[] and challenge_flags=[] even though AX-001 passes only 1/4 axes, Pareto orthogonality fails, non-degenerate sleeve mix fails, RF-R5 style/crowding thresholds are breached, and risk_challenge_note.md is missing.

AX-005/AX-007 multi-sleeve exception is not proven: the package admits true multi-sleeve is only STR_1715 + C2, daily cross-corr is 0.8491, lower TDC is 0.6154, diversification ratio is only 1.027, and non_degenerate_sleeve_mix_evidence.pass=false.

Crowding/active-book comparison is built on a 2026 STR_1715 static top20 proxy held through 2004-2026, not the actual PG2 active book schedule; this weakens RF-R5, AX-001 MDD complement, and TDC claims.

Tail-risk gate is not cleared: CVaR_95 is not reported in the package and auditor recomputation from C2 monthly history gives CVaR_95=0.1145 > 0.025 cap; GFC max drawdown is 39.16%, and EVT-GPD falls back to normal because only 17 exceedances exist.

RF-R1 is active but unflagged: auditor decomposition of C2 systematic variance shows SEC_건강관리_Ret contributes 44.6% > 40%; package checks only top-sector name count at 35%, which is not the same as systematic risk contribution.

Sigma numeric checks pass, but decomposition auditability is incomplete: exposure_matrix.parquet is B_dt with beta/log_size/sector dummies, while the actual B_full factor-loadings matrix used for Sigma is not saved; method shopping Sample/LW/Gerber/DCC and selection_objective are absent.

AX-001 v2 conditional defense fails: crisis_alpha is positive, but Core-relative MDD complement fails, bad/normal IC ratio is 0.7152 < 1, C2 CDaR is worse than STR_1715, and C2 beta evidence is not lower than STR_1715.

Required downstream/schedule artifacts are absent: qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260513_002/weights.csv, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, and qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260513_002 are missing, so weight schedule, turnover, cost, and AX-008 triangulation cannot be verified.

supporting_arguments: covariance.parquet itself is symmetric PD: min eigenvalue=0.0531, max eigenvalue=4.0158, condition number=75.67.
factor_covariance.parquet is PD with condition number=30.46; Omega LW shrinkage intensity recovered as lambda=0.0957.
alpha_scores.parquet has a real time series: 79,085 rows, 268 signal dates, 2004-01-30 to 2026-04-30.
C2 top20 liquidity floor is not the binding issue: package reports min ADV 2.38e8 KRW and 0 names below 2e8.
Name concentration HHI is acceptable for the hypothetical 70/30 combination at 0.0313; the problem is correlation/TDC, not HHI.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the actual STR_1715 active-book time series would produce the same or worse RF-R5/TDC than the static 2026 top20 proxy.
Whether a real optimizer weights.csv can keep turnover <600%, cost at 15bps one-way, max_names=20, and weight bounds [0,0.20] while adding C2.
Whether C13/C15 RAWDATA and sign-alignment exceptions have explicit governance approval.
Whether factor-level risk contribution should force sector/factor caps before optimizer handoff.
Whether CVaR_95 cap breach requires infeasibility_report before any conditional approval.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest risk claim is that a hypothetical 70/30 STR_1715+C2 blend, measured against a static 2026 STR_1715 top20 proxy, is sufficient evidence for AX-005/AX-007 multi-sleeve exception despite RF-R5 crowding, AX-001 1/4 pass, and non_degenerate_sleeve_mix_evidence=false.
rebuttal_required: Produce risk_challenge_note.md that explicitly addresses AX-001 1/4, RF-R1, RF-R5, RF-R8, CVaR cap breach, and non-degenerate sleeve failure.
Save the actual B_full factor-loading matrix used in Sigma and provide Sample/LW/Gerber/DCC method_shopping_log with selection_objective.
Recompute crowding/TDC/style correlation versus the actual STR_1715 PG2 active-book schedule, not a static 2026 top20 proxy.
Provide weights.csv and verify schedule, max_names=20, bounds [0,0.20], long-only, sum(w)=1, turnover<600%, and 15bps cost.
Compute mandatory CVaR_95 and ES_99 with bootstrap CI or issue infeasibility_report if cap remains breached.
For CRISIS/bad regime n=29, provide bootstrap CI or pooled/fallback regime-Sigma policy.
rationalization_red_flags: 1 source (risk-research only); awaits Optimizer + Forge + Architect

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package has useful raw diagnostics, but the risk conclusion is too soft: numeric Sigma health does not offset RF-R5 crowding, RF-R1 factor concentration, missing weights schedule, missing challenge note, and failed AX-001/AX-007 evidence.

risk_specific_questions: Why are red_flags and challenge_flags empty when Pareto orthogonality, AX-001, and non-degenerate sleeve mix all fail?
Can RF-R5 be recomputed against actual STR_1715 historical active weights rather than a 2026 static top20 replay?
If CVaR_95 remains above 0.025, where is the required infeasibility_report before optimizer handoff?
